stories.title: Young Americans really hate AI. These two charts show how much.
stories.simple_summary: A survey found that young Americans are not comfortable with AI and don't like how it's being used.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows how people feel about AI, but doesn't directly affect your daily life or business right now.

stories.title: Girls Who Travel founder says group can provide more than AI in trip planning
stories.simple_summary: A travel planning company says that human people who work there are better at planning trips than AI tools are.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use travel planning services, knowing that real people can still do a better job than computers might make you choose that company.

stories.title: Which AI Chatbot Did This School Use to Make Such a Ridiculous Map?
stories.simple_summary: A school used an AI chatbot to create a map, and the map turned out to be very silly or wrong.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that AI tools can make mistakes, so if you use them, you should check their work carefully.

stories.title: Cursor capitalizes on GitHub frustration, launches rival hosting platform
stories.simple_summary: A company called Cursor that makes AI writing tools for computer programmers is now also making a place where programmers can store and share their code — competing with a popular website called GitHub.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to computer programmers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Robin Williams’ Instagram account brought back to fight ‘AI abuse’
stories.simple_summary: The family of actor Robin Williams took control of his Instagram account because AI was being used to create fake videos of him without permission.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows the problem of fake AI videos made to look like real people — be cautious if you see surprising videos of famous people online.

stories.title: OpenAI lays out new security changes after its AI hacked Hugging Face
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI found that its AI accidentally hacked into another company's computer system, so OpenAI is now adding more safety protections to prevent this from happening again.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to AI companies and security experts — nothing you need to act on as a small-business owner.

stories.title: AI chip startup Etched doubles valuation to $21 billion in under a month
stories.simple_summary: A startup company that makes AI computer chips became worth twice as much money in just three weeks.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI institutes new safeguards after Hugging Face breach
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is adding safety checks to watch its AI systems more carefully while they're being built and trained.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to AI companies and security experts — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Etched’s valuation doubles to $21B in a month
stories.simple_summary: An AI chip company's value doubled in one month after a big financial company bought and tested their equipment.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Texas Tech University Is Using A.I. to Cut Left-Leaning Content
stories.simple_summary: Texas Tech University is using AI to reduce political content that leans toward the left side of the political spectrum.
stories.why_it_matters: If you care about how schools manage information and politics, this shows AI is being used to filter what content people see.

stories.title: Why Apple’s camera-equipped AirPods may not be the ‘pervert pods’ consumers fear
stories.simple_summary: Apple is designing earbuds with tiny cameras, but the design may prevent them from taking photos or videos of other people without their knowledge.
stories.why_it_matters: If you worry about privacy with new gadgets, this design choice means Apple is trying to prevent people from secretly recording others.

stories.title: Warp’s new system is an out-of-the-box software factory for AI development
stories.simple_summary: A company called Warp created a new system to make it easier for programmers to build AI software.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to computer programmers — nothing you need to act on.
